name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PrivateMIFE.literal_dec_calls
title: Exact single-input decryption count for the literal BKS selective recurrence
statement: With one base decryption at arity one and two lower-arity decryptions plus one single-input operation per higher-arity call, an arity j+1 decryption invokes exactly 2^(j+1)−1 single-input decryptions.
